attchmntText: We herewith enclose the Monitoring Agency Report for the Quarter ended September 30, 2026. Detailed letter is enclosed.
voiceSummary: SEPC Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of proceeds from its Rights Issue aggregating Rs. 350.00 crore. The report was issued by Infomerics Valuation and Rating Limited. The company received gross proceeds of Rs. 337.43 crore. No utilization of funds occurred during the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Shareholder approval for the variation in objects was obtained via Postal Ballot on March 07, 2026. The amount earmarked for Non-Convertible Debentures was revised from Rs. 140.00 crore to Rs. 15.80 crore. Rs. 124.20 crore was redirected to working capital requirements. Promoter and promoter group shareholding dropped to 9.39% as on September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: We herewith enclose the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. Detailed letter is enclosed.
voiceSummary: SEPC Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, on November 11, 2026. Consolidated profit after tax for the half-year was a loss of 6,959.11 lakhs, compared to a profit of 2,484.54 lakhs in the previous year. Standalone profit after tax for the half-year was a loss of 8,773.74 lakhs. The statutory auditor issued a qualified conclusion. The qualification relates to Deferred Tax Assets of 16,230.77 lakhs and non-current contract assets and trade receivables totaling 14,882.90 lakhs. The auditor cited insufficient evidence regarding the recoverability of these balances and future taxable profits. The company will publish an extract of the results in English and Tamil newspapers. Detailed results are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.
